# YuE2 Studio

> YuE2 Studio is a desktop music workstation with one library for YuE2, ACE-Step and MiniMax songs. The Create panel selects the model and engine, including supported local engines and OpenRouter music models. With YuE2 you can generate an editable ABC score and render new takes from it. You can import older Studio libraries, compare recordings, change singing voices with RVC, edit stems and MIDI, align lyrics, and train and apply LoRA adapters. Use the Studio MCP server to inspect installed capabilities and control the running application.

For an agent given this repository: install the studio from the latest release, start it, connect to its MCP server, and read the skill the server serves (resource `studio://skill`, prompt `studio`) - it names every tool, what the model reads, and the recipes. Start every session with the tool `studio_status`.

## Connect

- MCP endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp` (Streamable HTTP; protocol 2026-07-28 stateless, and 2025-11-25 / 2025-06-18 / 2025-03-26 through `initialize`)
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http yue2-studio http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp`
- Other clients: `{ "mcpServers": { "yue2-studio": { "type": "streamable-http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8791/mcp" } } }`
- Only agents on this computer and the studio's own window may connect; there is no key.

## Docs

- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/timoncool/YuE2-Studio/main/docs/mcp-skill.md): every tool by area, the model's writing rules, step-by-step recipes (the same text the server serves as `studio://skill`)
- [README](https://github.com/timoncool/YuE2-Studio#readme): what the studio does, what it needs, models and where they go
- [Latest release](https://github.com/timoncool/YuE2-Studio/releases/latest): the installer and the portable archive
- [Project page](https://timoncool.github.io/YuE2-Studio/)
